mapper.sql: g.id, st.id AS student_id, st.student_no, u.real_name AS student_name, c.id AS course_id, c.name AS course_name, g.score, g.grade_level, g.credits, g.status, g.semester, g.create_time
FROM grade g JOIN student st ON st.id = g.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = st.user_id JOIN course c ON c.id = g.course_id
